caption: The drawing depicts a table with a rectangular top that has rounded ends, colored in shades of brown to represent a wood grain texture. The top of the table and the upper portions of the legs are filled in with brown coloring, while the lower half of the table and legs are outlined in pencil without any color fill. The table has a central column composed of three carved, vertically fluted supports that connect to a single base with three curved legs, rendered in simple outline. There is handwritten text in pencil on the right and bottom of the image, partially overlapping with the table’s legs, with several lines of cursive writing. The background of the drawing is plain, uncolored paper.
title: Table
